caption:
I'm 41, I lift heavy — and I eat almost 2,000 calories a day 🍽️ Up to 2,500 on training days.

So why are so many active women still trying to survive on 1,200?

When you constantly under-eat, your energy drops, your recovery suffers, and building muscle becomes so much harder.

You don't need another extreme diet. You need proper nutrition, balance and consistency.
A strong body isn't built by starving yourself.

DM me "PLAN" and let's create a nutrition plan that fits your goals and your life 💪

#nutritionforwomen #strengthtrainingforwomen #womenover40 #personaltrainersingapore #fitmum
